column2: (2) A person who was a shareholder of the company at the

column1: time of the winding-up or during the preceding year shall be
jointly  and  severally  liable  to  pay  the  unpaid  tax  to  the

received as a shareholder within one year prior to its winding-

column2: (3) A person liable for tax of a company under this section

column1: may invoke any rights as against the Department that would
have been available to the company.

column2: (1) Where an entity fails to pay tax on time, every

column1: person who is or has been a manager of the entity at any time
since the relevant time shall be jointly and severally liable
with the entity and every other such person for payment of
the tax.

column2: (2) Subsection (1) shall apply irrespective of whether the

column1: entity has ceased to exist or not.

column2: (3)  Provisions  of  subsection  (1)  shall  not  apply  to  a

column1: manager  who  has  exercised  the  degree  of  care,  diligence,
and skill that a reasonably prudent person in the position of
the manager would have exercised in preventing in the initial
and continuing failure to pay tax.

column2: (4) Amounts payable to the Commissioner-General by a

column1: manager under this section shall be a personal tax liability
of the manager.

column2: (5)  Where  a  manager  pays  tax  by  reason  of  a  liability

column1: under subsection (1), the manager may recover the payment
from the entity as a debt due.

column2: (6) A manager of an entity may not be assessed for an

column1: amount under this section after the period of limitations for
collecting the relevant tax from the entity has expired.
